title: centaurea sphaerocephala subsp. lusitanica
intro: Centaurea sphaerocephala subsp. lusitanica, commonly known as the Portuguese knapweed or red knapweed, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, as well as its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea sphaerocephala subsp. lusitanica include flavonoids such as kaempferol and quercetin, terpenoids like ursolic acid, and sesquiterpenes, which may have therapeutic actions in modulating the immune system and reducing inflammation.
